trials.claim: Tier 6 includes Unlimited Users, 20 Production robots, 10 Application robots and Unlimited Flows
trials.claimQuote: Unlimited Users - 20 Production robots - 10 Application robots - Unlimited Flows - 1-minute Robot scheduling
trials.reasoning: No exhibit confirms the Tier 6 counts, and the extra-user/robot prices are regular prices that do not show deal buyers being charged, while the generic right to set reasonable limits does not contradict the specific tier.

exhibits.quote: Need more? Add users for $9/mo each, or extra robots from $19/mo (Application), $49/mo (Development), and $99/mo (Production).
exhibits.argument: The vendor charges extra per user and per robot, which undermines unlimited users and large included robot counts.

exhibits.quote: You agree that Robomotion retains the right to create reasonable limits on Robomotion’s use and storage of the Content
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to impose limits, which undermines a promise of unlimited usage.

trials.claim: AI builds the automation flow from plain English description with no coding required
trials.claimQuote: Tell the AI what you want to automate so it can build the flow for you—no coding required
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly reports the tool requires coding knowledge, or at least AI-assisted coding, which conflicts with the claim that no coding is required.

exhibits.quote: This tool does have a large learning curve, and requires coding knowledge (or at least AI-vibe coding to help you through).
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports coding knowledge is required, contradicting no coding required.

exhibits.quote: Output may be inaccurate, incomplete, out of date, biased, offensive, or otherwise inappropriate, and may appear correct or authoritative while being wrong (sometimes called “hallucination”).
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits AI output may be wrong, undermining that AI reliably builds the flow from description.

exhibits.quote: Create automations, apps, agents and forms by describing them, in the tools your team already works in.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states automations can be created simply by describing them.

exhibits.quote: Learning curve is steep but let face it, us your ai you like tell ai what you want from the flow and using robomotion.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms telling the AI what you want from the flow builds it.

trials.claim: Automates multi-step web tasks like logging in, pulling data, and sending reports and automatically catches and fixes flow errors
trials.claimQuote: Automate multi-step web tasks like logging in, pulling data, and sending reportsTurn repetitive manual tasks into fully automated bots in minutesAutomatically catch and fix errors in your flows to keep your bots running smoothly
trials.reasoning: The vendor warns automations may not operate error-free or as intended, and a buyer spent days failing on a basic web element, materially undercutting reliable multi-step automation with automatic error fixing.

exhibits.quote: Automations and AI agents may not operate error-free or as you intended and may produce unexpected results.
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits automations may fail and produce unexpected results, contradicting automatic error fixing and smooth running.

exhibits.quote: I have spent several days and nights trying to make a TextArea bind with a value but all XPaths have failed.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports multi-day failure automating a basic web task, contradicting reliable multi-step web automation.

exhibits.quote: Your workflows run on a robot that signs in, clicks, reads and types across your ERP, bank, CRM, tax portal and help desk, even where there's no API.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms the robot signs in, clicks, reads and types across business systems.

exhibits.quote: great multi-level error handling, and the support has been Excelente! Faik answers all my questions.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the product has multi-level error handling.

trials.claim: Stores login credentials in encrypted vaults and shows bots, schedules, users and usage from single dashboard
trials.claimQuote: Store login credentials securely in encrypted vaults, where only you can decrypt itemsSee your bots, schedules, users, and usage from a single dashboard
trials.reasoning: No exhibit confirms encrypted vaults or a single dashboard, and the privacy and user-responsibility terms do not directly show those features do not exist.

exhibits.quote: Users acknowledge and agree that there is no expectation of privacy concerning the transmission of Your Content and Your Data.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims privacy for transmitted content, undermining secure encrypted vault storage.

exhibits.quote: Users shall have access to the Content and shall be responsible for all changes to and/or deletions of Content and the security of all passwords, encryption keys and other Access Protocols required in order to access the Services.
exhibits.argument: The vendor places security of passwords and encryption keys on the user, undermining secure vault protection.

trials.claim: Previous customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow Robomotion to change the agreement, prices, and billing at any time in its sole discretion, which materially limits a guarantee that prior customers will always be grandfathered.

exhibits.quote: The agreement is subject to change by Robomotion in its sole discretion at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change terms unilaterally, undermining a promise to grandfather prior customers.

exhibits.quote: Robomotion reserves the right at any time to change its prices and billing methods, either immediately upon posting on Robomotion Properties or by e-mail delivery to you.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change prices and billing at any time, undermining locked-in limits and features.

exhibits.quote: Since picking it up on AppSumo, there have been countless upgrades and new features that keep adding real value.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms AppSumo purchasers received countless upgrades and new features.
